## 2.1.7

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nicoid:** Fix videos opened from external links always starting in normal playback regardless of the configured playback method
* **nicoid:** Restore correct external-link playback behavior for the playback selection prompt, video information, popup playback, background playback, and fullscreen playback
* **nicoid:** Fix the normal playback screen shifting underneath the status bar after exiting fullscreen in landscape mode, causing the video information tabs and other content to become obscured

### 🔧 Improvements

* **nicoid:** Apply external-link playback preference changes immediately by synchronizing the corresponding Android link-handling activities without requiring an app restart
* **nicoid:** Preserve existing saved preferences and in-app playback behavior while updating external-link routing
* **nicoid:** Restore status-bar inset handling after fullscreen exit, including repeated transitions, without accumulating extra top spacing
